text.card: A red giant 3,223 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.09 solar masses and 6.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,982 K at its surface.
